name: Robin Padilla
role: Philippine senator (since 2022), actor and earlier political campaigner
summary: Padilla advocates federalism and greater regional power, economic opening to foreign investors, and selected state-led economic measures. His record combines mandatory military training and capital-punishment proposals with advocacy for divorce, same-sex civil partnerships and tightly regulated medical cannabis; these do not establish support for same-sex marriage or unrestricted recreational drugs.
